text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's you! Heh, yesterday was<n>pretty fun!
choice_data_list: It seems you enjoyed your day off.
It seems you enjoyed your day off.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You bet! I watched a movie where the<n>bad guy was
the star! He ran wild<n>and did whatever he wanted!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
He was swingin' around weapons,<n>kickin' the
butts of goody-good<n>heroes, and knockin' out
anyone that<n>looked at him funny!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Watchin' it's given me all this<n>energy! I'm ready to
go wild!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It appears Shinko Windy made the<n>most of her
break and feels<n>revitalized!
